f.title: Identify whether you are a combination product applicant or a constituent part applicant
f.statement: A combination product applicant is an applicant that holds the application(s) for a combination product. A constituent part applicant is the applicant for a constituent part of a combination product whose constituent parts are marketed under applications held by different applicants. An applicant is a person holding an application (BLA, NDA, ANDA or device application, including amendments and supplements) under which a combination product or constituent part has received marketing authorization.

f.applicability: Combination products (21 CFR 3.2(e)) that have received marketing authorization
f.processes: Reporting policy; Case processing & follow-up

f.title: Submit five-day and malfunction reports of NDA/ANDA/BLA combination products through the 314.80(g) or 600.80(h) electronic route
f.statement: You must submit five-day reports and malfunction reports (§ 4.102(c)(1)(i) and (ii)) in accordance with § 314.80(g) if your combination product received marketing authorization under an NDA or ANDA, or in accordance with § 600.80(h) if it received marketing authorization under a BLA.
f.applicability: Combination products with a device constituent part authorised under an NDA, ANDA or BLA
f.processes: E2B / transmission; Submission operations; Safety system configuration

f.title: Submit fifteen-day reports of device-authorised combination products under 803.12(a)
f.statement: You must submit fifteen-day reports identified in § 4.102(c)(2)(ii) and (c)(3)(ii) in accordance with § 803.12(a) if your combination product received marketing authorization under a device application.
f.applicability: Combination products with a drug or biological constituent part authorised under a device application
f.processes: E2B / transmission; Submission operations; Safety system configuration

f.title: Constituent part applicants: keep records under the rules for their application type
f.statement: If you are a constituent part applicant, you must maintain records in accordance with the recordkeeping requirements in the applicable regulation(s) described in § 4.102(b).
f.applicability: Combination products (21 CFR 3.2(e)) that have received marketing authorization
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Audit & inspection readiness

f.title: Keep records of information shared with other constituent part applicants for the longest applicable period
f.statement: If you are a constituent part applicant, you must maintain the records required under § 4.103(b) for the longest time period required for records under the postmarketing safety reporting regulations applicable to your product under § 4.102(b).
